summary: The PR adds `startswith` and `endswith` methods to the `Query` class in `tinydb/queries.py`. Both use `_generate_test`, which safely resolves the path and returns `False` for missing fields (`KeyError`) or type errors (`TypeError`). The lambdas guard with `isinstance(value, str)` so `None`, numbers, and missing fields never match and never raise. All new tests pass (both memory and JSON storage fixtures) and the full existing test suite passes. Manual edge-case checks confirm correct behavior.

checks.evidence: tests/test_startswith_seed.py test_startswith, test_endswith, test_non_strings_do_not_match all pass

checks.claim: non-string fields (None, number, missing) do not match and raise no error
checks.evidence: snippet run: startswith A on [{name:5},{name:None},{x:1},{name:'Al'}] returned ['Al'] with no error

checks.claim: full existing test suite still passes
